answer: Sybil defence rests on priced enrolment plus stake-weighted quorum: each new identity must post a bond and reveal a mirror of its owner's address, so a thousand fake personas cost a thousand bonds, each needing real capital up front. Voting weight scales with stake, so splitting a balance across keys adds no influence, and colluding identities need an independent lantern attestation whose signer loses reputation if they misbehave. Exit has a delay, so a river of withdrawals cannot outrun slashing and honest agents can seize the bond pool of an attacker farming rewards at scale.
